note_data.title: Kevin Saver - Right shoulder pain and diabetes follow-up

sections.title: Chief complaint
sections.text: Right shoulder pain.

sections.title: History of present illness
sections.text:
Kevin Saver is a 36-year-old male who presents today for right shoulder pain.
Three weeks ago, he experienced a sharp twinge in his right shoulder while helping his son move a sofa up the stairs, which transitioned into a persistent ache localized to the top of the right shoulder and extending into the upper arm. The pain is aggravated by reaching overhead and putting on a shirt, and worsens at night when rolling onto the affected side, prompting him to sleep on the opposite side. He denies numbness, tingling, or weakness in the arm or hand. He has tried ice, Tylenol, muscle rub, and ibuprofen for relief, with only temporary improvement from ibuprofen and concern about stomach irritation.
He is concerned about blood sugar control, noting home glucose readings of 160-180 mg/dL in the morning and 140 mg/dL or higher before dinner. He attributes recent dietary changes and decreased activity to the holidays and colder weather. He denies increased thirst, nocturia beyond his usual pattern, blurred vision, or new tingling in the feet.
He describes feeling down and low in energy for approximately two months, coinciding with the passing of his brother. He reports decreased enjoyment in activities, increased sleep, and reduced appetite. He denies thoughts of self-harm. He notes feeling empty and less engaged than usual.
He reports recurrent heartburn, especially at night, and admits to missing omeprazole doses on weekends. He denies blood in stool or black stools.
He has a history of type 2 diabetes diagnosed in 2010, hypertension diagnosed in 2015, hyperlipidemia, and GERD. Surgical history includes laparoscopic cholecystectomy in 2010 and appendectomy at age ten. He reports penicillin allergy with hives in his twenties, without respiratory or facial swelling. Family history includes mother with heart disease and fatal myocardial infarction, father with type 2 diabetes, and aunt with breast cancer. Brother had heart disease.
